channel.title: Congress Report Card weekly digest
channel.description: Missed votes, grade changes and bills that became law, every Saturday.

item.title: Week ending November 14, 2026
item.description:
Here is what changed in the public record of Congress from November 7 to November 14, 2026.

Votes this week

The House held 9 roll-call votes and the Senate held 6 roll-call votes. 425 of the 533 members who could vote cast every vote.

Most votes missed this week

  1. J. Luis Correa (D, CA-46) missed 9 of 9
  2. Neal P. Dunn (R, FL-2) missed 9 of 9
  3. Monica De La Cruz (R, TX-15) missed 7 of 9
  4. Nancy Pelosi (D, CA-11) missed 7 of 9
  5. Christopher Murphy (D, CT) missed 6 of 6
  6. Byron Donalds (R, FL-19) missed 6 of 9
  7. Maria Elvira Salazar (R, FL-27) missed 6 of 9
  8. John Cornyn (R, TX) missed 5 of 6
  9. Catherine Cortez Masto (D, NV) missed 5 of 6
  10. John W. Hickenlooper (D, CO) missed 5 of 6

Bills that became law

  • HR 7730: Bankruptcy Threshold Adjustment Act. Sponsored by Ben Cline (R, VA-6).
  • HR 997: National Taxpayer Advocate Enhancement Act of 2025. Sponsored by Randy Feenstra (R, IA-4).
  • HR 1703: Choices for Increased Mobility Act of 2026. Sponsored by John Joyce (R, PA-13).
  • HR 1945: America's National Churchill Museum National Historic Landmark Act. Sponsored by Robert F. Onder, Jr. (R, MO-3).

Grade changes

41 members moved to a different letter grade. Bill scores are ranked within each chamber, so a grade can move when other members' records change.

Biggest gains

  • Derek Schmidt (R, KS-2): B- to B
  • Lloyd Smucker (R, PA-11): C to C+
  • Kirsten E. Gillibrand (D, NY): B- to B
  • Michael Cloud (R, TX-27): C to C+
  • Jon Husted (R, OH): C+ to B-

Biggest drops

  • J. Luis Correa (D, CA-46): C- to D+
  • Jeff Merkley (D, OR): A- to B+
  • Monica De La Cruz (R, TX-15): C- to D+
  • Lisa Murkowski (R, AK): C- to D+
  • Byron Donalds (R, FL-19): D- to F

See every member's grade at congressreportcard.org, or read how grades are calculated.
